arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('src/eywa/ast.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('''        result_type = table[rtname]
        _need(isinstance(result_type, Void) or not isinstance(underlying(result_type), Void)
              or True, "result type")
        if isinstance(underlying(result_type), Void):
            pass
        _need(rname not in scope, "result name collides with a parameter")''',
'''        result_type = table[rtname]
        _need(rname not in scope, "result name collides with a parameter")''')
# relax depth guards: the documented bounds protect us; keep a generous ceiling
s = s.replace('MAX_DEPTH = 64', 'MAX_DEPTH = 256')
p.write_text(s)

p = pathlib.Path('src/eywa/oracles.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('''from .ast import (Alias, Array, Bool, Char, Enum, Int, String, Struct, Void,
                  underlying, int_width)
from .errors import InvalidCampaign''',
'''from .ast import Alias, Bool, Char, Enum, Int, String, Struct, Void, underlying
from .errors import InvalidCampaign''')
p.write_text(s)

p = pathlib.Path('src/eywa/offline.py')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('''from .ast import (Alias, Array, Bool, Char, Enum, Int, String, Struct, Void,
                  build_modules, build_types, compile_predicate, underlying)''',
'''from .ast import build_modules, build_types, compile_predicate''')
p.write_text(s)
PYEOF
python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'src'); import eywa.offline, eywa.ast, eywa.oracles" && grep -n "int_width\|MAX_DEPTH" src/eywa/*.py
